Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000495" [decision]: As of 2025-06-25, the job scheduler is owned by team Dune.  (about: team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000502": As of 2025-06-11, team Dune owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then.  (about: Boreal team, team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000343": Team Dune adopted a monthly game day.  (about: team Dune)
- memory_id "1000128": The reporting service is owned by team Dune.  (about: team Dune, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000545": Team Dune sits on the fourth floor.  (about: team Dune)
- memory_id "1000551": Tomasz left the Atlas team and joined team Dune on 2025-07-30.  (about: Atlas team, Tomasz, team Dune)
- memory_id "1000099" [decision]: Farah takes the first on-call rotation for team Dune.  (about: Farah, team Dune)
- memory_id "1000050": Farah runs team Dune solo until the next hire lands.  (about: Farah, team Dune)
- memory_id "1000633": As of 2025-09-04, Tomasz holds the Dune on-call shift, having picked it up from Farah.  (about: Tomasz, Farah, team Dune)
- memory_id "1000491": On 2025-06-25, Oskar walked Farah through the job scheduler's runbook.  (about: Farah, Oskar, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000261" [decision]: Lena takes over the pager rotation for the Boreal team from Marcus in the cycle starting 2025-03-17.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000599" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the old Tuesday 13:00-15:00 UTC window is retired.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000281": Team Dune observed that the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: team Dune, the cache change, notification service)
- memory_id "1000604": Team Dune observed that the image resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: team Dune, image resizer, the runtime upgrade)
- memory_id "1000110": The Cinder team owns the product catalog.  (about: Cinder team, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000448" [decision]: The Ember team decided that the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000451": The job scheduler's single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000180": The job scheduler depends on feature-flags for per-job kill switches.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000542": The Ember team runs its planning on Fridays.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000409" [decision]: As of 2025-05-15, the webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher)
Existing entity names: team Dune, job scheduler, Boreal team, notifier, reporting service, Atlas team, Tomasz, Farah, Oskar, Lena, Marcus, the cache change, notification service, image resizer, the runtime upgrade, Cinder team, product catalog, Ember team, feature-flags, webhook dispatcher
